posts.quote: Many of the mothers most at risk are girls who were married before 18, and the state often meets them for the first time in a labour ward.
Where one competitor pays and most do not, compliance becomes a competitive disadvantage rather than a baseline.
The lesson is not that Pakistan should reproduce the AIFC model in full, but that institutional credibility depends on more than legislation alone.
The public record thins out at the production stage.
Fewer conversions is not, on its own, proof of a lower total cost.
The legal problem is that a discretion cannot be underwritten.
The PAVE record establishes that Pakistan’s binding constraint in this sector is not policy ambition but administrative execution.
Pakistan is a market to serve rather than a platform to export from.
Battery-pack assembly is the strongest single opportunity identified in this report.
